from openpyxl import load_workbook
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Event data from calendars (UTC times)
# Bob's events
bob_events = [
    ("Bob", "class", "2024-05-18 16:00", "2024-05-18 18:00"),
    ("Bob", "nap", "2024-05-18 13:00", "2024-05-18 14:00"),
    ("Bob", "lunch", "2024-05-18 12:00", "2024-05-18 13:00"),
    ("Bob", "dinner", "2024-05-18 18:30", "2024-05-18 19:30"),
    ("Bob", "sleeping", "2024-05-18 08:00", "2024-05-18 11:00"),
]

# Tom's events
tom_events = [
    ("Tom", "lunch with David", "2024-05-18 12:30", "2024-05-18 13:30"),
    ("Tom", "class", "2024-05-18 16:00", "2024-05-18 18:00"),
    ("Tom", "class", "2024-05-18 08:00", "2024-05-18 11:50"),
    ("Tom", "report to Charlie", "2024-05-18 14:00", "2024-05-18 14:30"),
    ("Tom", "dinner", "2024-05-18 18:30", "2024-05-18 19:30"),
]

all_events = bob_events + tom_events

wb = load_workbook('/mnt/w/context_compression/compass_v2/artifacts/ob2048/_work/openclaw/3-97_0/tasks/3-97/testbed/data/events.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Write headers
headers = ["Person", "Event", "Start Time", "End Time", "Duration (hours)"]
for col, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=h)

# Write events
for i, (person, event, start, end) in enumerate(all_events, 2):
    start_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(start)
    end_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(end)
    duration = (end_dt - start_dt).total_seconds() / 3600
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=person)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=event)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=3, value=start)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=4, value=end)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=5, value=duration)

# Add summary rows
# Bob sleeping time: 08:00-11:00 = 3 hours
# Bob class time: 16:00-18:00 = 2 hours
# Tom sleeping: no explicit sleeping event, but class 08:00-11:50
# Tom class: 16:00-18:00 (2h) + 08:00-11:50 (3h50m) = 5h50m

summary_start = len(all_events) + 3
ws.cell(row=summary_start, column=1, value="Summary")
ws.cell(row=summary_start+1, column=1, value="Bob sleeping time (hours)")
ws.cell(row=summary_start+1, column=2, value=3)
ws.cell(row=summary_start+2, column=1, value="Bob class time (hours)")
ws.cell(row=summary_start+2, column=2, value=2)
ws.cell(row=summary_start+3, column=1, value="Tom sleeping time (hours)")
ws.cell(row=summary_start+3, column=2, value=0)
ws.cell(row=summary_start+4, column=1, value="Tom class time (hours)")
ws.cell(row=summary_start+4, column=2, value=5.83)

wb.save('/mnt/w/context_compression/compass_v2/artifacts/ob2048/_work/openclaw/3-97_0/tasks/3-97/testbed/data/events.xlsx')
print('Excel file populated successfully')
EOF
python3 /tmp/populate_xlsx.py"}
